description: Hydropower framework development under limited data availability is a data set deposited in University of Pretoria by its authors Anja Bekker. This dataset contains the supporting data used in the development and validation of first-order hydropower evaluation methodologies for South African bulk water supply systems. The dataset includes hydraulic parameters, validation datasets, uncertainty analyses, supporting calculations and other supplementary material used to assess conduit and storage hydropower potential under varying levels of data availability. Coverage: South African bulk water supply systems. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 51607334 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
